feed.title: Mu He
feed.subtitle: Academic homepage of Mu He, Assistant Professor in the School of Mathematics and Physics at Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University (XJTLU). Research interests: biostatistics, reliability, and data-driven applications in statistics and public health.

entry.title: A new homepage
entry.content: The homepage has been rebuilt with al-folio, a modern academic theme for Jekyll, and is now served from this repository. Publications, teaching, projects, and news pages have been migrated from the previous R Markdown site.
entry.summary: The homepage has been rebuilt with al-folio.
